correctness.rationale: Exact run-pattern factor occurrence conditions for one through five runs yield all MAWs by a complete six-run candidate case analysis; higher run counts cannot have both boundary factors. Boundary cases a=b=c=1 and all positive exponents are covered. Independently computed entire factor sets for 1728 five-run parameter triples and 342 one-/three-run words matched, and the seven-run counterexample was checked; the proof, rather than finite testing, establishes the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The three-parameter antidual factor language is completely classified with a closed count requiring only run comparisons, and a sharp structural threshold is proved for all low-run binary palindromes. These are motivated invariants of run-length-compressed palindromic strings; seven runs genuinely permit nonpalindromic MAWs. Not a routine reparameterization or a finite-table extension.
